basic_details.job_title: Rajarshi Shahu Arts and Commerce College, Rukadi Principal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Balasaheb Mane Education Trust, Rukadi has invited applications for one post of Principal, open to all, at Rajarshi Shahu Arts and Commerce College, Rukadi, Tal. Hatkanangale, Dist. Kolhapur (affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur). Applications go to the President of the Trust within 15 days from publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 4 November 2026, which gives a last date of about 19 November 2026 (15 days from 4 November 2026). The notice does not say whether the date is for dispatch or receipt.

qualification.details: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales remains in force. The post of Principal is treated as open category, per the Aurangabad Bench High Court decision in W/P No. 3108/2023, the Supreme Court special leave petition W/P No. 4172/2024 and letter No. RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. | The notice does not print the minimum educational qualification, experience or age. Candidates should check the official notification and the prescribed rules for the post's eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Rajarshi Shahu College Rukadi Principal at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee, the selection process or a pay amount.

content_sections.heading: About Rajarshi Shahu College Rukadi
content_sections.text: Rajarshi Shahu Arts and Commerce College, Rukadi is run by Balasaheb Mane Education Trust, Rukadi, in Tal. Hatkanangale, Dist. Kolhapur (416 118, Maharashtra). The notice describes it as affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, and as "Permanently Granted". It states that the notice is to be published at www.unishivaji.ac.in .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications, pay scales and service conditions are as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The Government Resolution No. Misc-2018/C.R.56/18/UNI-1, dated 08 March 2019, for educational qualification and pay scales remains in force. The post of Principal is treated as open category, per the Aurangabad Bench High Court decision in W/P No. 3108/2023, the Supreme Court special leave petition W/P No. 4172/2024 and letter No. RJD/HE/KD/CIRCULAR/2024/2119 dated 09/05/2024 of the Regional Joint Director, Kolhapur Region, Kolhapur. The notice does not print the minimum educational qualification, experience or age. Candidates should check the official notification and the prescribed rules for the post's eligibility.

rows.pay: As prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: Appointment to the post of Principal will be for a period of 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the attainment of the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier. Vacant posts and all terms and conditions are applicable as mentioned in No Objection letter No. JDHE/Kolhapur/NOC/2026/00011 dated 19.10.2026 from the Deputy Secretary (Higher Education), Mantralaya, Mumbai. All terms and conditions are also applicable as mentioned in the GR dated 12.11.2021 of the Higher and Technical Education Department, Government of Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q1. How many Principal posts are vacant at Rajarshi Shahu Arts and Commerce College, Rukadi?
faq.answer: One post of Principal is vacant, and it is open to all (Open to All - 01).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Rukadi Principal post?
faq.answer: Applications are due within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement. The notice is dated 4 November 2026, so the last date is about 19 November 2026 (15 days from 4 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for the Principal post?
faq.answer: Apply giving full particulars to the undersigned, the President of Balasaheb Mane Education Trust, Rukadi, Tal.-Hatkanangale, Dist. Kolhapur. Incomplete applications will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification is as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The Government Resolution dated 08 March 2019 on qualification and pay scales remains in force.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for the Principal post?
faq.answer: The pay scale is as prescribed by the apex body, Govt. of Maharashtra and Shivaji University, Kolhapur from time to time. The Government Resolution dated 08 March 2019 on pay scales remains in force.

faq.question: Q6. For how long is the Principal appointed?
faq.answer: The appointment is for 5 years from the date of appointment or up to the age of superannuation of the candidate, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Principal post reserved for any category?
faq.answer: No category is reserved. The post is treated as open category and shown as Open to All - 01, per the High Court and Supreme Court matters and the Regional Joint Director's letter quoted in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. Can a person already in service apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but applicants who are already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Is this recruitment subject to any court decision?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the recruitment procedure is subject to the decision of the Bombay High Court, Aurangabad Bench, on writ petition No. 12051/2015.
